codeCard.metric: mean absolute RGB difference over entire image, units 0..255

limits: Not a full real-time viewing of the final MP4 or continuous animation review; keyframe phases and actual encoded-preview provenance are the final-media checks here. Earlier no-caption continuous-motion inspection remains recorded separately in qa-preflight.md/json.
No ASR, full human listening, pronunciation/transcription sign-off, or user-comprehension experiment claimed.
Shared same-SHA full decode and loudness measurements were read and verified by identity; this agent did not repeat full decode or loudness measurement.
Code-card stability is measured after decoding and scaling to 480×270; compression makes frames slightly different, so static does not mean byte/pixel identical.
Covers were previously viewed in qa-preflight; they were not reopened in this final-MP4 check. Online deployment and published-copy SHA checks are outside this report.
